request.prompt:
Deliverable: landscape flat API guide infographic for software engineers.
Primary request: explain the TypeSafe official API request and response shape in one visual.
Composition: left column is a large card "State" with three blank subcards for order, customer message, and policy. Middle column is a card "Questions" with three colored cards "Choice", "Score", "Noul". A central arrow points to a dark endpoint card "POST /v1/systemone". Right column is a response card "answers" with three blank typed result rows and one probability gauge. A small bottom strip shows "固定模型版本" and "记录 model + confidence".
Style and medium: flat technical infographic, warm paper, teal / coral / mustard modules, strong black arrows, precise grouping, no 3D, no photorealism.
Text (exact): Allowed readable text only: "TypeSafe 官方 API：State + Questions → Answers", "State", "订单 / 原话 / 政策", "Questions", "Choice", "Score", "Noul", "POST /v1/systemone", "answers", "固定模型版本", and "记录 model + confidence". Render each exactly once. All JSON keys, numbers, code, and secondary fields must be blank abstract placeholders.
Avoid: extra words, fake URLs, duplicated labels, misspellings, watermark.
